about.title: About the archive & editorial principles
about.meta: Our approach to inclusion, tags, source verification and image licensing.
about.heading2: Understand a little more of the world.
about.description: A concise, verifiable and growing biographical archive.
about.why1: Some people expand the boundaries of knowledge, others shape everyday life, and some confront the world with new problems. We bring scattered achievements, life stories and key events into readable profiles, giving curiosity somewhere to begin.
about.why2: Fame is not a single kind of honor. Inclusion rests on documented public influence and sufficiently reliable sources, not approval of someone’s views, actions or work. The ordering is an editorial browsing sequence, not a ranking of achievement.
about.tagsTitle: Tags that allow lives to overlap
about.domains: Eight broad fields guide navigation, while more specific tags describe disciplines, works and achievements. People may belong to several fields, so field totals can exceed the number of people.
about.erasTitle: Eras: based on periods of activity
about.eras: Pre-1500, early modern (1500–1799), modern (1800–1945) and contemporary (1946–present). A person may span several eras. These are navigation conventions for this site, not a historical periodization shared by every region.
about.regions: Regional tags combine birthplaces, places of upbringing and long-term activity. They are not equivalent to a single nationality or judgments about historical or present-day borders. Country and cultural associations are listed separately in each profile.
about.keywords: Relativity, commercial spaceflight, modern literature… Keywords connect people from different backgrounds. Click a profile tag to return to the matching filtered results.
about.sources1: We prioritize institutional archives, universities, museums, award organizers and reliable reporting. Summaries are written in our own words, with discreet source links beside key milestones and achievements. References appear at the foot of each profile. Official biographies can also be selective, so independent or statutory sources are added where possible for contentious matters.
about.sources2: Timelines run from most recent to earliest and select significant turning points. A verification date is not a news coverage cutoff; each profile states its scope separately. Living people’s positions and public activities may change. This site does not provide live biographies or fill timelines with unverified recent claims.
about.sources3: The birth and death dates of ancient figures may come from traditional accounts and cannot be treated as equivalent to modern archival records. Uncertainty is stated where relevant. Judgments, allegations and disputes retain their distinct meanings; an allegation is not presented as an established fact.
about.photosTitle: Every image must show the right person
about.photos1: Each person has one source image with an explicit identity label, together with its author, source page, license and verification date. Paintings or later likenesses of historical figures are clearly marked as historical portraits. Generated faces are not substituted for photographs of real people.
about.photos2: Images are stored locally and may be cropped for display. Living people retain the original image colors; deceased people are shown in black and white. Image rights remain with their creators or relevant rights holders, and each image follows its own license.
about.photosLink: View complete image credits and licenses
about.expansionTitle: Starting with one edition, expanding gradually
about.expansion: There are currently {count} completed profiles and an initial framework of {total} candidates. The list still reflects biases in era, geography and source availability. Later editions will expand it and revisit its representation. Candidates without completed research do not receive empty profile pages.
